sar.narrative: Customer C12865, holder of card C12865-K1, is the subject of this report due to suspicious electronic activity involving structured online purchases. Between 2016-12-26 14:49 and 2016-12-26 15:11, 3 transactions totaling $1,289.91 were executed online using device profile 'Trident/7.0 | Windows 10 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1920x1080'. The specific transactions include $429.98 (transaction 3576364 on 2016-12-26 14:49), $429.96 (transaction 3576365 on 2016-12-26 14:49), and $429.97 (transaction 3576415 on 2016-12-26 15:11). Each amount was kept just below a $500 authorisation threshold, and the purchases occurred within 22 minutes of one another. This burst pattern of similar amounts in a short period is indicative of transaction structuring designed to evade standard risk controls. When contacted by the bank, the cardholder confirmed that they did not make the $429.97 transaction and still retains physical possession of the card. Although the model score was 0.000 and bank risk score was 0.08, 8 of the 8 most similar closed cases (including CC-2989, CC-2888, CC-0164, and CC-1476) represent confirmed fraud. In response to this activity, the bank has executed automated actions including creating a case and escalating to an analyst, while recommending Level 1 card blocking and Level 2 SAR filing.
